spanish: Y cuando se empobreciere tu hermano contigo y se vendiere a ti, no lo servirás servicio de siervo.

findings.issue: Qal תעבד has the addressee as worker; בו marks the brother (sold to the addressee) as the one worked, and עבדת עבד is the slave-service imposed. «lo servirás» makes the brother the person served.
וכי is only a conjunction; «cuando» locks a temporal reading and leaves if/that/because closed.

notes: Niphal «se vendiere» and «servicio de siervo» stay within the tokens; 2fs suffixes on עמך and לך are not a person change in tú.
